proof_summary: Introduce the auxiliary recurrence \(x_0=1,\ x_1=-2,\ x_{n+2}=-4x_{n+1}-64x_n\); algebra shows that both \(x_{n+1}^2\) and the odd-indexed subsequence satisfy \(u_{n+3}=-48u_{n+2}+3072u_{n+1}+262144u_n\). Their first three values agree, so induction gives the desired square representation at every index.
